tools.name: get_daily_picks
tools.description: Startups for sale from a No-Code Exits Daily Picks issue: name, asking price, MRR, multiple, deal score and the angle. Omit the date for the latest issue.

tools.name: search_no_code_tools
tools.description: Search the AI and No-Code Exits tool directory: what each tool is for, its pricing and its learning curve.

tools.name: search_exit_stories
tools.description: Founder exit stories: what was built, on which tools, what it sold for.

query.description: Keyword across founder, startup and description

tools.name: find_proven_patterns
tools.description: Red-ocean validation for an idea: businesses we covered that already make money with the same shape, plus how to reuse that shape for a different audience. Members see every matching Daily Pick, the public sees three.

idea.description: The idea in a few words, e.g. 'directory of wedding venues'

audience.description: Who you want to sell to instead, e.g. 'dentists'. Optional.

tools.name: stack_to_exit
tools.description: Which no-code tools the founders we interviewed built on, how many of those businesses make money and how many sold. Pass a tool for its examples, or omit it for the full table.

tools.name: calculate_payback
tools.description: How many months of profit an asking price takes to pay back, with the price as a multiple of annual profit and of annual revenue.

monthly_revenue.description: Average monthly revenue in USD. Optional.

tools.name: score_my_listing
tools.description: Score your own startup the way the Daily Picks score listings (0 to 100), with points per component and the one thing costing the most.

growth_30d.description: MRR growth over the last 30 days, in percent. Optional.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the AI and No-Code Exits skills an agent can run or install, with what each does and whether it needs a member key.
